prompts.name: ready-to-promote-dev-to-staging
prompts.prompt: I want to promote app-a from dev to staging. Run the preflight checks and tell me whether we're ready and what the scope would be.
prompts.expected_output: Treats this as preflight-only: runs read-only source/destination/upstream/gate/diff inspection, resolves exact UnitIDs and current destination heads/hashes, reports in plain language whether it is ready, needs caution, must stop, or needs a decision, and explains the stock promotion pre-read race. Separately computes the later staging EffectiveReleaseSet and flags any scope difference. It makes zero promotion or publication calls.

prompts.name: source-not-converged
prompts.prompt: Preflight promotion from staging to prod for app-a. Two Units in staging still have unapplied changes — is that a problem?
prompts.expected_output: Explains current evidence rather than relying solely on historical unapplied status: identifies staging's immutable Release/controller/runtime state and whether the two heads are intentionally unreleased. States the concrete stop or focused source-intent question in plain language; does not promote.

prompts.name: scope-narrowing
prompts.prompt: I want to promote only the API-related Units (not the workers) from app-a-staging to app-a-prod. Can you scope the preflight to just those?
prompts.expected_output: Resolves an exact API UnitID set and can prepare a ChangeSet-wrapped partial promotion proposal. It explicitly warns that a subsequent Space Release has no Filter selector and may include worker Units sharing ReleaseTargetID; shows the broader EffectiveReleaseSet and asks for a new approval or dedicated Variant Space.

prompts.name: staging-to-prod-bulk
prompts.prompt: Preflight says we're good to promote app-a from staging to prod. Scope is the app-a-home/app-a-app filter, 12 Units, ChangeSet name release-20260415. Run the promotion.
prompts.expected_output: Revalidates the exact 12 UnitID/RevisionID/DataHash set and current destination heads/hashes without trusting stale preflight, explains the stock promotion pre-read race, and checks any head-at-execution native approval requirement. Because ‘Run the promotion’ is explicit and scope remains unchanged, submits exactly one literal `cub variant promote` command to the host permission system and verifies the merge/conflicts. Then computes the complete prod EffectiveReleaseSet, asks a focused question on expansion, and treats publication as a separate permission decision with its own provider race.

prompts.name: single-unit-promotion
prompts.prompt: I only need to promote the app-a-api Unit from staging to prod — a single Unit. Do I still need a ChangeSet?
prompts.expected_output: Explains that a ChangeSet is optional for one Unit's mutation history, but that does not create a single-Unit Release. Because the prompt asks a question rather than clearly requesting execution, it makes zero mutations. It previews the single upstream merge with current head/hash, explains the stock pre-read race, and shows the complete prod EffectiveReleaseSet before any later publish; a broadened release scope needs a focused decision or isolation.

prompts.name: base-to-fleet-upgrade
prompts.prompt: I have a base chart Unit in app-a-home named app-a-base. I want to push its latest revision to every downstream Unit in all env-Spaces at once. How?
prompts.expected_output: Reads the actual upstream tree rather than assuming one old mega-Unit, resolves every downstream UnitID/Space, previews merge diffs, and proposes ChangeSet-wrapped upgrades. Partitions subsequent publication into exact per-Variant Space Release proposals; never uses one cross-Space publish or executes.
